title: Fourier truncation reconstruction
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $k\in\mathbb N$, and $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Then $f^{\le k}(x)+f^{>k}(x)=f(x)$, where the two parts retain Fourier coefficients with $|S|\le k$ and $|S|>k$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
x is a point of the Boolean cube
replaced:
For every $f$, every level $k$ and every point $x$ of the cube,
$f_{\le k}(x) + f_{>k}(x) = f(x)$.
